games.title: Gamified Symptom Screening Hub
games.subtitle: Mental health is never a flaw. Replace cold, clinical questionnaires with stigma-free mini-games that map your cognitive and emotional traits.
games.disclaimer: Game scores (such as 7/10) are indicative screening metrics to assist clinical evaluations, not a formal medical diagnosis. Final diagnosis and prescriptions remain the sole duty of licensed clinicians.
games.game1Desc: Measures reaction consistency, peripheral distractors, and focus drift in 3 minutes.
games.game2Desc: Visual scenario navigation capturing emotional reactivity and energy-shift patterns.
games.game3Desc: Symmetry and sorting puzzle measuring uncertainty tolerance and checking loops.
games.scoreAdhdDesc: Reaction telemetry indicates sensitivity to peripheral distractors and impulse spikes.
games.scoreMoodDesc: Moderate emotional reactivity with fluctuating circadian energy patterns.
games.scoreOcdDesc: Low likelihood for checking loops; high tolerance for asymmetrical patterns.
games.addToDossier: Add Scores to My Ready Doctor File
games.findSpecialists: Find Doctors Specializing in These Traits

era.title: Online ERA: Emotional Resonance & Anxiety Screening
era.subtitle: A rapid, stigma-free behavioral screener measuring somatic reactivity, sensory load, and anxiety regulation.
era.disclaimer: This assessment outputs indicative decision-support scores for clinical use, not a formal medical diagnosis.
era.q1Title: When facing an unexpected high-stakes task:
era.q1Opt1: Immediate heart rate surge and task paralysis
era.q1Opt2: Moderate anxiety, but able to break it down
era.q2Title: In crowded spaces with loud ambient noise and bright lights:
era.q2Opt1: Rapid sensory depletion and urge to escape
era.q2Opt2: Mild discomfort, manageable for limited time
era.q3Title: When anxiety spikes, how does your body respond?
era.q3Opt1: Severe muscle clamping, neck tightness, or GI distress
era.completedSubtitle: Your indicative score is ready for your clinical dossier.
era.highNotice: Elevated somatic and sensory reactivity. Recommended for clinical review.
era.normalNotice: Balanced emotional regulation under daily stressors.
